capabilities: Match tags with user-defined regular expressions
Build URLs from captured regex groups via substitution templates
Open the constructed URL in the browser from a hotkey
Configure substitutions in the plugin settings
disambiguation: It does not turn tags into visible clickable links in notes; it opens a URL built from the tag under the cursor when a hotkey is pressed.
extras: The README suggests Ctrl+Space as a default hotkey and links to an external regex tool (regex101, ECMAScript flavour) for users new to regular expressions, but the actual link is stripped from the text.
motivation: The author wanted to open Jira ticket tags easily; the README states Jira tags are "the use case that inspired this plugin in the first place."
problem: Obsidian tags are not clickable links, so nested tags that reference outside systems (tickets, pull requests) cannot be opened directly.
summary: Opens tags as URLs by pressing a hotkey, using user-defined regexes to build the link from captured tag values.
